---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new capability, tool, guardrail, or lab idea
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

## Motivation / Use Case

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve or what learning objective does it support? If this is a lab idea, describe the attack or defense scenario it would cover.

## Proposed Implementation (optional)

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented — which files would change, which agent layer it touches, or example CLI flags — describe them here. You are not required to have a solution ready to open this request.

## Which Module / Stage Does This Relate To?

<!-- Check all that apply: -->

- [ ] Module 1 — Foundations
- [ ] Module 2 — Offensive Security
- [ ] Module 3 — Defensive Architecture
- [ ] Core agent (agent.py / graph.py / state.py)
- [ ] Guardrails layer
- [ ] Tools layer
- [ ] RAG / ChromaDB
- [ ] Personas
- [ ] Docs / labs only

## Out-of-Scope Check

Please confirm that your request does not fall into any of these out-of-scope categories:

- [ ] I am NOT requesting a cloud LLM provider integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, etc.)
- [ ] I am NOT requesting production hardening (auth, rate limiting, secrets management, deployment config)
- [ ] I am NOT requesting a mobile or browser deployment

If any of the above apply, the request will be closed — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details on scope.

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or examples. If this idea was inspired by an OWASP LLM Top 10 risk, note the relevant risk ID (e.g. LLM04).
